note: Rustic campground on the shore of Perch Lake, 23 mi NW of Newberry via M-123 and County Road 407; managed by Muskallonge Lake State Park. Stairway to the lake mid-campground and a launch on the south side; a boating access site with a skid pier is reached from CR 410 or the campground entrance. The in-campground road is a bit rough and some sites are hard to level for big rigs. ORVs and snowmobiles may ride between the campground and nearby trails. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20 (confirmed), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 32 sites (all confirmed, derived -> manual); sites #12 and #14 are tent-only walk-ups. Season 'open all year' (roads not plowed) already manual, left. Phone 906-658-3338 (Muskallonge Lake SP) matches. Not equestrian. ORV operation between the campground and the Pine Ridge / Two Heart trails is allowed (amenity table 'yes'), but the DNR doesn't describe it as an ORV trail camp. Access via M-123 and CR 407, no road warning. Note trimmed of field restatements.
